prompts.forklift_presence: Is a forklift visible in this image? Answer with only yes or no.
prompts.pallet_presence: Are any pallets visible in this image? Answer with only yes or no.
prompts.pallet_count: How many pallets are clearly visible in this image? Answer with only a single whole number.

attestation.statement: I accept LOCO's manual bounding-box annotations as the reference for the derived presence/count questions in this manifest.
attestation.citation: Mayershofer, C., Holm, D.-M., Molter, B., Fottner, J. LOCO: Logistics Objects in Context. IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA), 2020.

count_rule_proxy_note: pallet_count is an annotation-based proxy: LOCO human bounding boxes whose relative area is >= min_area_frac. It is NOT a human-verified count of clearly visible pallets.
